description: This Java source file defines the ThingsAggregatorProxyActor class, an Akka actor that acts as a client proxy for retrieving Thing entities via streaming, handling RetrieveThings and SudoRetrieveThings commands, and managing responses through SourceRef streams.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorProxyActor
